data.name: Illisha
data.gender_notes: Illisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit name Ila, meaning 'goddess'. This name embodies the grace and blessings of the divine feminine. In Hindu mythology, Ila is the wife of Vishnu's avatar, Vamana. She is known for her beauty and kindness. The name Illisha carries the meaning “Goddess Ila's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Illisha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess ila's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the divine feminine grace and nurturing spirit.
